components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'MR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Retained for backward
            compatibility: an owner may instead supply the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields, which are preferred when
            present. On create it is normalized. Either a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or this flat 'address' must be supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the flat
            'address'. It is normalized on create exactly like 'address', and the
            normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. a
            unit or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form the
            composed 'address'. The normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present; a number in national trunk form (a
            leading '0') is treated as Australian, so the '0' is dropped and country
            code '+61' prepended (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'),
            while any other bare number is treated as NANP and country code '+1'
            prepended. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and its
            national-number length must match the country code ('+61' requires 9
            national digits, '+1' requires 10); otherwise the request is rejected
            with 400. The stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099); a postcode out of range for the city's
            region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. It is optional: an owner created without a postcode
            is still accepted. When given it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint accepted only when creating an owner. The household is
            keyed on (last name, postcode), so a second owner in an existing
            household is rejected as a household duplicate with 409 unless this flag
            is set, in which case the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. This flag is never persisted
            or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Identity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the identifiers derived for this owner,
        grouped together under the owner response's 'identity' object. Every
        value is rederived by a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2'
        version tag, so no value produced under version 1 recurs.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The pet owner's unified member id, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the version-2 region code
            (the fixed 'V2' tag followed by the canonical region derived from the
            postcode, or 'V2UNKNOWN' when it resolves no region), FY is the last
            two digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted
            registration date (fiscal year starts 1 July, named by the year it
            ends in), HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of
            SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' tag concatenated with the normalized
            telephone and the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
            computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household: the
            first twelve upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2'
            tag joined by '|' to the normalized last name (trimmed, collapsed
            whitespace, lower-cased) and the postcode. Owners sharing a last name
            and postcode therefore share the same value automatically. Absent
            when the owner has no postcode.
          type: string
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the full lower-case hex
            SHA-256 digest over
            'V2|<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
            A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this whole key
            equals that of an existing owner; because the normalized telephone
            is part of the key, two members of the same household with different
            telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
          type: string
          example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this pet owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by
                a single space ('<title> <lastName>'), or just the last name when
                no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'MR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes from
                the left (e.g. '+61412345678' is shown as '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response schema. Always 2 for the
                version-2 owner identity.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity, grouping the memberId, householdId
                and identityKey. These identifiers are no longer exposed at the top
                level of the owner.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Identity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an
                email is present, plus 1 when the owner's namesakeCount is 0,
                plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of three or more
                members, plus 3 when the owner's tenure (elapsed fiscal years
                since its registration date) exceeds one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level, derived from its
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, taken from the REGION component of the
                owner's memberId (the region derived from the postcode);
                'UNKNOWN' when no member id or region is present.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from its locality (region)
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether an unusually high number of owners have been created today.
                True once more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city is approaching the per-city capacity limit
                of 50 owners. True when the city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners (inclusive); otherwise false. The hard rejection at 50 is
                unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether the owner should be flagged for review. True when any of
                these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate, the email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (on or sharing a second-level label with a known
                disposable email provider), or the owner's city is over its soft
                capacity (holds at least 40 owners, the capacity-warning threshold).
                Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel for the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date is present.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year it ends in, so a registrationDate
                on or after 1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year
                (e.g. 2026-08-09 -> 'FY27'). Absent when no registration date is
                present.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the full lower-case hex
                SHA-256 digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this whole key
                equals that of an existing owner; because the normalized telephone
                is part of the key, two members of the same household with different
                telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                flagged at creation as a possible duplicate of an existing owner
                because it shares that owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode while
                producing a different identity key. False when no such match exists.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone).
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while
                retaining the record, and the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'MR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Retained for backward
            compatibility: an owner may instead supply the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields, which are preferred when
            present. On create it is normalized. Either a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or this flat 'address' must be supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the flat
            'address'. It is normalized on create exactly like 'address', and the
            normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. a
            unit or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form the
            composed 'address'. The normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present; a number in national trunk form (a
            leading '0') is treated as Australian, so the '0' is dropped and country
            code '+61' prepended (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'),
            while any other bare number is treated as NANP and country code '+1'
            prepended. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and its
            national-number length must match the country code ('+61' requires 9
            national digits, '+1' requires 10); otherwise the request is rejected
            with 400. The stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099); a postcode out of range for the city's
            region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. It is optional: an owner created without a postcode
            is still accepted. When given it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint accepted only when creating an owner. The household is
            keyed on (last name, postcode), so a second owner in an existing
            household is rejected as a household duplicate with 409 unless this flag
            is set, in which case the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. This flag is never persisted
            or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Identity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the identifiers derived for this owner,
        grouped together under the owner response's 'identity' object. Every
        value is rederived by a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2'
        version tag, so no value produced under version 1 recurs.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The pet owner's unified member id, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the version-2 region code
            (the fixed 'V2' tag followed by the canonical region derived from the
            postcode, or 'V2UNKNOWN' when it resolves no region), FY is the last
            two digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted
            registration date (fiscal year starts 1 July, named by the year it
            ends in), HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of
            SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' tag concatenated with the normalized
            telephone and the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
            computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household: the
            first twelve upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2'
            tag joined by '|' to the normalized last name (trimmed, collapsed
            whitespace, lower-cased) and the postcode. Owners sharing a last name
            and postcode therefore share the same value automatically. Absent
            when the owner has no postcode.
          type: string
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the full lower-case hex
            SHA-256 digest over
            'V2|<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
            A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this whole key
            equals that of an existing owner; because the normalized telephone
            is part of the key, two members of the same household with different
            telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
          type: string
          example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this pet owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by
                a single space ('<title> <lastName>'), or just the last name when
                no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'MR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes from
                the left (e.g. '+61412345678' is shown as '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner response schema. Always 2 for the
                version-2 owner identity.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity, grouping the memberId, householdId
                and identityKey. These identifiers are no longer exposed at the top
                level of the owner.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Identity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an
                email is present, plus 1 when the owner's namesakeCount is 0,
                plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of three or more
                members, plus 3 when the owner's tenure (elapsed fiscal years
                since its registration date) exceeds one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level, derived from its
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, taken from the REGION component of the
                owner's memberId (the region derived from the postcode);
                'UNKNOWN' when no member id or region is present.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from its locality (region)
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether an unusually high number of owners have been created today.
                True once more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity. Because the DTOs are generated from `openapi.yml`, I changed the schema there and updated the derivation logic and mapper.

**Identity derivation (V2 — mixes in a fixed `V2` tag so no v1 value recurs):**
- `OwnerIdentity.identityKey` — added a `VERSION_TAG = "V2"` constant; the SHA-256 source is now `V2|<tel>|<email>|<soundex(lastName)>`.
- `householdId` (controller) — source is now `V2|<lastNameKey>|<postcode>`.
- `memberId` (controller) — the **region code inside the identifier** is now `"V2" + region` (e.g. `V2NSW`, `V2UNKNOWN`), and `HASH8` hashes `"V2" + tel + lastName`. The Luhn check still runs over the digits of `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`.

**Keeping `locality`/`timezone`/segment plain (never tagged):**
- `locality` and `timezone` no longer read the (now-tagged) `memberId`; the mapper derives them directly from the postcode via `OwnerLocality.forPostcodeOrUnknown` / new `timezoneFromPostcode`, so `locality` stays `NSW` and the owner segment's region stays plain (`STANDARD_METRO` for NSW).

**Response shape:**
- Added an `Identity` schema (memberId, householdId, identityKey), nested under a new `identity` object on `Owner`, and removed those three top-level fields.
- Added top-level integer `apiVersion` (constant `2`) via the mapper.

**Audit schema v2:**
- `emitOwnerCreatedEvent` now emits `{"schemaVersion":2, seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, ownerSegment, event:"OWNER_CREATED"}`, with the owner segment recomputed from the version-2 identity.

**Test change:** the one existing V1 assertion pinning top-level `$.identityKey` was updated to `$.identity.identityKey` to match the new (spec-mandated) response shape. Request fields are unchanged.
